notes: Representative human-reviewed subset of the FIPS 186-4 -> FIPS 186-5 revision. Anchored on changes documented by NIST when superseding 186-4: DSA is removed as a generation algorithm (retained only for verification), EdDSA (Ed25519/Ed448) is added, deterministic ECDSA per RFC 6979 is referenced, and domain-parameter requirement wording was restructured. Quotes are substrings of extracted glyph text, so they survive line wrapping but must match verbatim after whitespace collapsing.
